matches.why: Growing a circle of competence outward = studying adjacent businesses one after another.

contradictions.why: Sold Herbalife when a named thesis-breaker (GLP-1 results) appeared: neither an upgrade nor a misunderstanding, against Rsell1's 'only'. Rsell2 (model vs outcomes) could be stretched to cover it, but the card records no such scope. Supported by SOS1-C040 (risk named in advance).

Sold Celanese and Ashland on valuation in his early days; card says no price/valuation sell trigger and sell only to upgrade. Self-dated as early career (later wins would close it), but the card does not record this change of view.
Cut Herbalife as growth proved elusive (re-based on 2014-21, SOS1-C038): fits Rsell2 (outcomes vs model, update model) and Rsell1's 'misunderstood the business'; not a true opposite.
